question: In July 2025, which institute launched Gyanodaya for pedagogical innovation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIM Kozhikode**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IIM Kozhikode** launched **Gyanodaya** in **July 2025** as a platform for pedagogical innovation, aiming to enhance teaching methodologies and learning experiences.
 
• The initiative seeks to integrate **technology** and **modern pedagogical tools** to create a transformative impact on education delivery.
 
• **Gyanodaya** focuses on promoting ** across disciplines, emphasizing research-driven and experiential learning approaches.
 
• It aims to address the evolving needs of higher education** by fostering collaboration among educators, researchers, and industry professionals.
 
• IIM Kozhikode, located in **Kozhikode, Kerala**, is known for pioneering educational initiatives and contributing significantly to management and leadership development in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IIM Kozhikode:**

 
 
• **Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (IIM Kozhikode)** was established in **1996** and is one of the premier management institutes in India.
 
• Located in **Kozhikode, Kerala**, it is renowned for its focus on **academic excellence**, **research**, and **innovative programs**.
 
• The institute offers **postgraduate programs**, **doctoral programs**, and **executive education** catering to diverse aspects of management studies.
 
• IIM Kozhikode is particularly known for its unique initiatives such as **interactive online learning** and programs for **women entrepreneurs**.
 
 
 
• **Pedagogical Innovation:**
 
 
• Pedagogical innovation refers to the use of **new methodologies**, **technologies**, and **tools** to improve the teaching-learning process.
 
• It aims to address the challenges of traditional education methods by promoting **personalized** and **active learning**.
 
• Examples include **flipped classrooms**, **experiential learning**, **gamification**, and the integration of **AI in education**.
 
• Such innovations enhance student engagement, critical thinking, and skill development, making education more effective and future-oriented.
 
 
 
• **Educational Collaboration:**
 
 
• Collaborations between **academic institutions**, **industry leaders**, and **research organizations** play a pivotal role in advancing education.
 
• They help bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical applications, ensuring students are prepared for real-world challenges.
 
• Such partnerships foster the development of **innovative curricula**, **research projects**, and **training programs**.
 
 
 
• **Role of Technology in Education:**
 
 
• **Technology** has emerged as a key enabler in modern education, facilitating access to resources, interactive learning, and remote education.
 
• Tools like **virtual classrooms**, **AI-driven learning platforms**, and **educational apps** have revolutionized teaching methods.
 
• It allows for **personalized learning experiences**, catering to the unique needs and pace of individual students.
 
• Technology also enables **data-driven decision-making** for educators, improving the effectiveness of teaching strategies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **About Gyanodaya:**

 
 
• Gyanodaya is an initiative to explore and implement **innovative teaching practices** in the field of management education.
 
• The program emphasizes the integration of **modern pedagogical tools** and **technology** to address the challenges of traditional teaching methods.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Pedagogical Innovation:**
 
 
• Pedagogical innovation ensures that education evolves to meet the changing demands of society and the workforce.
 
• It promotes **critical thinking**, **problem-solving skills**, and **active learning**.
